mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, longitude, latitude, business_type, intro, food_contact_name, food_contact_phone, food_recommended_dishes FROM business WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT fr.public_url FROM business_file_relation bfr JOIN file_resource fr ON fr.id = bfr.file_resource_id WHERE bfr.business_id = #{businessId} AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fr.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY bfr.sort_no ASC, bfr.file_resource_id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.model, c.seat_num, c.description, fr.public_url AS image_url FROM business_travel_car c LEFT JOIN file_resource fr ON fr.id = c.image_resource_id AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fr.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.business_id = #{businessId} AND c.status = 'ENABLED' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.bed_spec, r.description, fr.public_url AS image_url FROM business_hotel_room r LEFT JOIN file_resource fr ON fr.id = r.image_resource_id AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fr.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.id ASC

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.description, fr.public_url AS image_url FROM business_food_dish d LEFT JOIN file_resource fr ON fr.id = d.image_resource_id AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fr.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE d.business_id = #{businessId} AND d.status = 'ENABLED' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.sort_no ASC, d.id ASC
